questions.question: In a classic five-stage RISC instruction pipeline (IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB), how does hardware data forwarding (operand bypassing) fundamentally mitigate performance degradation caused by Read-After-Write (RAW) data hazards?
options: By dynamically reordering non-dependent instructions at runtime using reservation stations to fill pipeline stall slots.
By routing computed execution results directly from pipeline register outputs (EX/MEM or MEM/WB) to ALU inputs before those results are written back to the register file.
By duplicating the ALU datapath so that dependent arithmetic operations can execute concurrently in the same clock cycle.
By speculatively predicting operand values and rolling back pipeline state if a value misprediction is detected.
By halting the instruction decode stage until the writeback stage completely updates the architectural register file.

questions.question: In digital CMOS circuit design and delay estimation, what does the concept of 'logical effort' (g) fundamentally characterize for a given logic gate?
options: The ratio of the gate's dynamic power dissipation to that of a minimum-sized inverter operating at maximum frequency.
The parasitic delay introduced by internal source/drain diffusion capacitance relative to the gate's load capacitance.
The number of series transistor stages required to decompose an arbitrary multi-input Boolean expression into standard cells.
The ratio of the gate's input capacitance to the input capacitance of an inverter designed to deliver the exact same output drive current.
The worst-case propagation delay of the gate normalized to the RC time constant of an unbuffered metal interconnect line.

questions.question: In low-power digital IC design implementing power gating (MTCMOS), what is the primary operational necessity of placing isolation cells at the boundaries between a power-gated domain and an always-on domain?
options: To clamp interface signals to a valid, deterministic logic level so that floating inputs do not cause short-circuit (crowbar) current or false switching in the active domain when the sleep domain is shut down.
To translate logic voltage levels between two actively powered voltage domains operating at different nominal supply voltages (VDD).
To synchronize control signals across unsynchronized clock domains using dual-stage flip-flop synchronizers to prevent metastability.
To store sequential register state across power-off cycles using low-leakage balloon latches powered by an auxiliary rail.
To throttle rush-in current across the power distribution network during power-up sequencing to suppress localized ground bounce.

questions.question: In shared-memory multi-core computer architecture, what memory operation reordering is permissible under the Total Store Order (TSO) memory consistency model (as implemented in x86 architectures)?
options: An older load operation can be delayed past a younger load operation to a different memory address (Load-Load reordering).
An older store operation can be delayed past a younger store operation to a different memory address (Store-Store reordering).
An older load operation can be delayed past a younger store operation to a different memory address (Load-Store reordering).
An atomic read-modify-write operation can be executed non-speculatively ahead of preceding memory fence instructions.
A younger load operation can be executed before an older pending store operation to a different address has drained to the memory system (Store-Load reordering).

questions.question: In dynamic Domino CMOS logic design, what is the primary operational role of a weak PMOS keeper (bleeder) transistor attached to the dynamic node, and what is its fundamental design trade-off?
options: It speeds up the discharging of the dynamic node during the precharge phase, at the expense of increasing peak subthreshold leakage.
It eliminates substrate noise and ground bounce across the pull-down network, at the expense of requiring double the clock tree drive strength.

It preserves the high logic level of the dynamic node against charge sharing and subthreshold leakage during evaluation, at the expense of current contention that slows down high-to-low evaluation and increases power.
It removes the requirement for a static CMOS inverter between cascaded dynamic stages, at the expense of introducing critical race conditions.
It forces rail-to-rail voltage swings during evaluation, at the expense of degrading the low-level noise margin (NML) of the receiving gate.
